answer.label: quantization
answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available, and every value matches quantization closely: top-1 agreement 0.957 (doc 0.951), sequence agreement 0.688 (doc 0.688), KL 0.039 (0.051 ± 0.018), TV 0.040 (0.051), Token-DiFR gap 0.037 (0.038) and raw-score shift 2.8 ×10⁵ (2.3). None is ruled out because the values are non-zero. The raw-score shift of 2.8, far below 10.4, rules out fine-tune bias, whose KL of 0.082 is also about double this one. Fine-tune backdoor is unlikely given its lower top-1 agreement (0.909), higher KL (0.15) and Token-DiFR gap of 0.15. Both system-prompt classes have KL of at least 0.24 and top-1 agreement of at most 0.89. Without activation data, the shrinking-size-ratio check that would confirm quantization was not possible.
